correctness.rationale: Eliminate common phase and use θ0=u+v, θ2=u−v, θ1=w+z, θ3=w−z, φ=w−u. Direct sine identities yield F=(-2sin v cos z cos(φ+α),−2sin z cos v cos(α−φ),−4cosα sinφ cos v cos z). Bounded smooth cofactors imply invariant lifted cube 0<v,z,φ<π. Direct differentiation proves dot H=dot J=0 for H=log(sin v sin z/sinφ) and J=log(sin v/sin z)+φ tanα; exact positive multiplier of ∇H×∇J proves functional independence off equilibria. The three equilibrium segments follow from factoring F, and the central normal pair obeys λ²=4(cos²φ0−sin²α). On fixed-J surface, H has a negative definite restricted Hessian in |cosφ0|<sinα; Morse regular levels yield nonstationary invariant circles and genuine nonlinear periodic relative-phase annuli, with period tending to π/√(sin²α−cos²φ0). Directly projected 200 independent four-phase configurations and checked both conservation derivatives numerically; this does not replace the invariant-surface/Morse proof.
